assignees.description: GitHub usernames to assign to this issue.

confidence.description: How confident you are in this choice. Use 'HIGH' for clear signal or explicit user request, 'MEDIUM' for reasonable inference with some ambiguity, 'LOW' for best guess with limited signal.

is_suggestion.description: If true, this assignee is sent to the API as a suggestion (suggest:true) rather than an applied assignee. Whether the assignee is applied or recorded as a proposal is determined by the API.

rationale.description: One concise sentence explaining what specifically about the issue led you to choose this assignee. State the concrete signal (e.g. 'Authored the file the crash originates in').
